2　4　6　8　8　8

(b) If the range of the time taken by the girls is also 1 minute more than that of the boys, find the standard deviation of the time taken by the girls.

questions.stem:
The stem-and-leaf diagram below shows the distribution of weekly wages (in dollars) of 30 staff members of a company.

It is known that the difference between the inter-quartile range and the range of the distribution is $3500.

(a) Find the median and the mean of the weekly wages of the 30 staff members.

(b) Write down the greatest possible standard deviation of the weekly wages of the 30 staff members.

(c) The manager proposed a pay rise for all the staff members in the company such that the median of their weekly wages will increase by 25% and the inter-quartile range will remain unchanged. Describe how the manager should raise the wages of each of the 30 staff members.

(a) 求該 30 名員工每週薪金的中位數及平均數。

(b) 寫出該 30 名員工每週薪金標準差的最大可能值。

questions.solutionZh: (a) 週薪中位數為 $9350，平均數為 $9450；(b) 最大標準差約 $1605.8；(c) 每人的週薪增加 $2337.50，中位數便增加 25%，四分位距不變。

questions.stem:
A test was carried out to see how quickly a class of students reacted to a visual instruction to press a particular key when they played a computer game. Their reaction times, measured in tenths of a second, are recorded and the statistics for the whole class are summarised below.

(a) Draw two box-and-whisker diagrams comparing the reaction times of boys and girls.

(b) Suppose a boy and a girl are randomly selected from the class. Which one will have a bigger chance of having a reaction time shorter than 1.1 seconds? Explain.

For (b), use the usual boxplot convention. Strict probabilities require more information about repeated reaction times.

(a) 繪畫兩個框線圖，比較男生與女生的反應時間。

(b) 從該班隨機各選一名男生及女生，誰的反應時間少於 1.1 秒的機會較大？解釋。

(b) 按框線圖的一般詮釋作答；若嚴格比較「少於」的概率，尚需重複數值的資料。
questions.solution: (a) Boys: (5,8,11,14,17); girls: (7,9,11,16,21). (b) Same chance under the usual median interpretation; strict probability is not determined by these summaries alone.

questions.stem:

(i) Draw two box-and-whisker diagrams of the same scale to compare the numbers of books read by the students in the first term and in the second term.

(ii) The librarian claims that not less than 50% of the students read at least 5 more books in the second term than in the first term. Do you agree? Explain your answer.

(i) 以相同比例繪畫兩個框線圖，比較兩學期閱讀的書籍數目。

questions.solution: (a) Median 18; IQR 13. (b)(i) Term 1: (3,12,18,25,30); term 2: (8,26,35,41,46), on the same scale. (ii) Agree: at least half read at least 35 books in term 2, while every student read at most 30 in term 1, so each of those students read at least 5 more.

The student union of a school conducts two surveys to measure the extent of the students’ satisfaction on the services provided by the school library. A score from 0 to 100 is used to measure the extent of satisfaction on the services, with 0 indicating absolute dissatisfaction and 100 indicating absolute satisfaction. The stem-and-leaf diagram shows the distribution of scores rated by 32 students in the first survey.

(a) Find the median, the range and the inter-quartile range of the above distribution.

(b) After six months, the student union conducts the second survey to these 32 students. The box-and-whisker diagram shows the distribution of scores rated by the students in the second survey.

(i) Is the distribution of scores in the second survey less dispersed than that in the first survey? Explain your answer.

(ii) The chairman of the student union claims that at least 25% of the students have a greater extent of satisfaction shown in the second survey than the first survey. Do you agree? Explain your answer.

(b) 六個月後，學生會向同一批學生進行第二次調查。框線圖顯示第二次評分的分布。

questions.solution: (a) 3. (b) Decreases: deleting a score equal to the mean preserves the mean but increases the standard deviation, reducing John’s positive standard score.
